# 🎓 Coursework Overview

A curated list of all **mathematics, statistics, and computer science** courses\
completed at **Pasadena City College (2020–2024)** and **UCLA (2024–2026)**.\
These courses form the core of my preparation for advanced study in Statistics & Data Science.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 🐻 UCLA Statistics & Data Science Major Coursework

### Programming & Applied Statistics

- **Introduction to Statistical Programming with R (STATS 20)**  
  <span class="course-ko">R을 활용한 통계 프로그래밍 입문</span>

- **Community or Corporate Internships in Statistics (STATS 195)**  
  <span class="course-ko">통계학 지역사회·기업 인턴십</span>

### Probability, Inference, and Mathematical Statistics

- **Introduction to Probability (STATS 100A)**  
  <span class="course-ko">확률론 입문</span>

- **Introduction to Mathematical Statistics (STATS 100B)**  
  <span class="course-ko">수리통계학 입문</span>

- **Linear Models (STATS 100C)**  
  <span class="course-ko">선형모형</span>

### Regression, Experiments, and Data Mining

- **Introduction to Data Analysis and Regression (STATS 101A)**  
  <span class="course-ko">데이터 분석 및 회귀분석 입문</span>

- **Introduction to Design and Analysis of Experiments (STATS 101B)**  
  <span class="course-ko">실험설계 및 분석 입문</span>

- **Introduction to Statistical Models and Data Mining (STATS 101C)**  
  <span class="course-ko">통계 모형 및 데이터 마이닝 입문</span>

### Computational & Theoretical Methods

- **Introduction to Computational Statistics with R (STATS 102A)**  
  <span class="course-ko">R을 활용한 계산통계학 입문</span>

- **Introduction to Computation and Optimization for Statistics (STATS 102B)**  
  <span class="course-ko">통계학을 위한 계산 및 최적화 입문</span>

- **Introduction to Monte Carlo Methods (STATS 102C)**  
  <span class="course-ko">몬테카를로 방법론 입문</span>

### Statistical Consulting

- **Practice of Statistical Consulting (STATS 140XP)**  
  <span class="course-ko">통계 컨설팅 실습</span>

- **Practice of Statistical Consulting (STATS 141XP)**  
  <span class="course-ko">통계 컨설팅 실습</span>

### Advanced Electives

- **Statistical Models in Finance (STATS C183)**  
  <span class="course-ko">금융 분야의 통계 모형</span>

- **Introduction to Digital Humanities (DGT HUM 101)**  
  <span class="course-ko">디지털 인문학 입문</span>
